info.title: ADR Guard - Architecture Decision Records Validator
info.description: Validate and maintain Architecture Decision Records from the command line. ADR Guard checks naming conventions, required sections, statuses, duplicate IDs, ADR references, and supersession links, and generates deterministic Markdown indexes.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Validate and maintain Architecture Decision Records from the command line.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Validate ADR files. Defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: draft
commands.description: Generate a Proposed ADR draft through a configured AI provider.

options.name: --model
options.description: Provider model identifier. ADR Guard does not choose a default model.

options.name: --culture
options.description:
.NET globalization culture name such as en-US or pt-BR.
Defaults to en-US.

options.name: --endpoint
options.description: only for openai-compatible; rejected for official providers.

options.name: --context-file
options.description:
Add an explicit .md or .txt context file. May be repeated.
Relative paths are resolved from the current working directory.

options.name: --include-existing-adrs
options.description:
Opt in to sending parsed existing ADR context to the provider.
ADRs are ordered deterministically and bounded to 12000 characters.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Generate and validate the ADR without writing a file.
Authentication is read only from environment variables:
openai                  OPENAI_API_KEY
anthropic               ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
gemini                  GEMINI_API_KEY
openai-compatible       ADR_GUARD_OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY (optional)
ADR structural headings and the Proposed status remain canonical.
Generated content is validated before a new ADR file is written.
Dry-run/preview uses the same deterministic ID and filename calculation,
validates the generated ADR, prints it, and does not write any file.

commands.name: index
commands.description: Validate ADR files and generate an index. Defaults to README.md.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show the application version.
Exit codes:
0  Success
1  ADR validation failed
2  Invalid command-line usage
3  Operational error
